limits: Same physical host; not host HA, power-loss certification, production IAM or arbitrary-vendor exactly-once.
Fixture bearer credentials exist only in owned lab volume; no customer accounts/data or real secrets in model/logs.
Stale restore goes only to inactive clone; queue/sink never rolled back or active DB replaced.
No core/BGP/VyOS/JKT, host routes/firewall, RTX, financial/CS/user services or process signals.
Assisted source and controlled transport exercise, not model training or unassisted universal autonomy.

resolutions: New protected Level10 adapter journals submit/control, probes journal readiness and resolves private bearer identity.
Recovery SQLite identity uses hosting api network child client.
Legacy schema4 preflight required before native; guarded rollback only known additive schema4.
Control intent/applied and journal barrier prevent pre-backup intent gaps.
Clone persists ORIGINAL control watermark; recheck at reconcile.
Unknown intents remain conservative until explicit same-key retry resolves; rejected not falsely accepted.
WAL, integrity, time/size caps, no-overwrite publish+fsync.
Global snapshot private operator scope not tenant download.
Bound tick selection and distinguish scheduling budget/in-flight transport/no SLA.

probe_label_correction.cause: Holder kind overwrote protected event envelope kind through trailing dict unpack; actual writer/lock timestamps and states remained in original observations.
